meta.title: Benchmarking: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a non-Buyer user and a Buyer in the same Enterprise tenant
Open Benchmarking and compare historical, budgeted, and custom benchmarks
Verify that the non-Buyer is refused or the feature is absent while the Buyer can use it
Record the tenant's RBAC configuration if access is intentionally granted to non-Buyer roles
